statement_en: Let $a_n$ be a positive real sequence that is increasing, and suppose that the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{1}{a_n}$ converges. Prove that $\sum_{n\geq 1} \frac{n}{a_1+\cdots+a_n}$ also converges.
callout_body: 已知正实数序列$a_n$是单调增加的，并且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{1}{a_n}$是收敛的，证明$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{n}{a_1+\cdots+a_n}$也是收敛的。
